claim: FSx for NetApp ONTAP Single-AZ file systems are built for use cases that need storage replicated within an AZ but do not require resiliency across AZs, such as development and test workloads or secondary copies of data already stored on-premises or in other AWS Regions, and they are cost-optimized for these use cases by only replicating data within an AZ.

values.display: only replicating data within an AZ
do not require resiliency across AZs

evidence.quote: Single-AZ file systems are built for use cases that need storage replicated within an AZ but do not require resiliency across AZs, such as development and test workloads or storing secondary copies of data that is already stored on-premises or in other AWS Regions.
Single-AZ file systems are cost-optimized for these use cases by only replicating data within an AZ.
